criterion: which news topic area the article covers

categories.name: Politics
categories.definition: Reports on government activities, elections, political parties, policy debates, and international diplomacy.

categories.name: Business and Economy
categories.definition: Coverage of corporate financial results, mergers and acquisitions, economic indicators, stock markets, and trade.

categories.name: Sport
categories.definition: News concerning professional and amateur sporting events, match results, athlete transfers, and related controversies.

categories.name: Entertainment and Arts
categories.definition: Articles on the film, music, and television industries, including awards, celebrity news, and cultural events.

categories.name: Technology and Internet
categories.definition: Reports on software, hardware, internet services, telecommunications, and cyber security developments.

categories.name: Science and Environment
categories.definition: News regarding scientific research, environmental issues, natural disasters, and space exploration.

categories.name: Law and Crime
categories.definition: Coverage of legal proceedings, criminal trials, policing, and security matters not strictly political.

categories.name: Lifestyle and Society
categories.definition: Features on social trends, health issues, education, and human interest stories.
